facts.boundary: THIS METHOD CANNOT CERTIFY ABSENCE. By the rule of three, a family with 0 hits in 40,000 docs is bounded above at 0.0075%, i.e. still up to ~200 docs domain-wide -- so a zero here means 'not found', never 'not present'. Separately, a 13-gram containment scan is the WRONG instrument for a family-level question in either direction: it answers 'did this exact text appear', so a generator emitting fresh instances scores 0 on it while the procedure is thoroughly present -- the 7.33% age_ratio rate is invisible to 13-gram containment. Consequence, and the reason this fact exists: a skill that is absent from pretraining must be CONSTRUCTED, not selected; absence is then a property of how it was built rather than a claim a scan is asked to support.

value.supersedes: the sets emitted earlier on 2026-09-05, whose prompts carried an ambiguous carry rule and whose operands field dropped any operand equal to 1, 2 or 3. Nothing was scored against those files.

reading_divergence_on_S.note: Measured ON THESE FILES. Earlier-quoted 46.8/72.1/48.3 were computed on the PRE-regeneration files and are wrong for these; e1 caught the discrepancy by reproducing independently. P is 0 by design -- its no-carry invariant is asserted in the generator -- so all three readings agree on every P item.

operand_magnitude_confound.why: P's range was widened from 6..19 to 6..80 on 2026-09-05 to supply 5,096 distinct instances; at S's own 3..19 only 428 no-carry (a,b) pairs exist across P's two programs, against the 5,096 the curve draws, so P CANNOT match S's operand distribution and supply a full pool. The constraint is structural: P has two operands where S has three or four.
operand_magnitude_confound.consequence: P is meant to differ from S in COMPOSITION only. It also differs in operand magnitude, and e1 sharpened what that costs: S at 3..19 over three or four operands keeps every intermediate inside two digits, while P at 6..80 reaches three, so the two families are different TOKENISATIONS of the operator and not only different difficulties.
operand_magnitude_confound.found_by: e1 (lessons-58) asked whether anything asserts P's ranges; nothing does, and the drift they hypothesised is the actual shipped state
operand_magnitude_confound.options_not_yet_ruled: (a) accept and report the confound with every curve; (b) drop P_pool -- if P is only ever a test-time control it needs 1,000 instances, not 5,096, and 3..40 supplies 2,024; (c) give P a third inert operand so its space grows without changing what it controls for.
operand_magnitude_confound.direction: UNKNOWN, and not merely unmeasured: two live mechanisms push opposite ways. Large-operand arithmetic being the harder axis makes P harder and understates the gap; procedure-following being the harder axis -- the thing the experiment exists to measure -- makes S harder for a reason unrelated to operand size and overstates it. An earlier version of this entry said 'plausibly understated', naming only the first mechanism; e1 caught that a signed guess in a boundary field gets quoted later without its hedge.
operand_magnitude_confound.option_b_measured: Dropping P_pool and drawing test-only from 3..40: 1,012 no-carry (a,b) pairs, x2 programs = 2,024 distinct (program, operands) keys against 1,000 drawn, a 2.02x margin under the real without-replacement draw (e1 asked for this before fb rules). But it does NOT remove the confound: 3..40's operand mean is 22.3 against S's 9.9, still 2.3x. Only 3..19 matches S (mean 11.3, 1.1x) and it supplies 428 keys, below the 1,000 needed. So option (b) narrows 4.9x to 2.3x and buys a pure format control at test time; it does not make the families magnitude-matched.

four_way_readout.chi2_vs_uniform: 1.936 on df=3 (critical 16.27 at p=0.001). An earlier header said 1.86; e1 recomputed 1.94 and the recheck gives 1.936, so 1.86 was mine and wrong.
four_way_readout.why: exact match has no headroom off a 0 floor at 200M (e1's MDE, fb ruling 2026-09-05), so experiment 1's primary readout is 4-way likelihood. Every distractor is the answer under a DIFFERENT misreading of the rule, so which option a model picks says which rule it applied -- the options are diagnostic, not filler.
four_way_readout.why_a_ladder: only 457 of 1000 items have four distinct values under the obvious three (add_until, no_carry, wrong_order); an eight-rung ladder of further misreadings brings it to 1000 with 0 short. A random-integer filler would have made those items measure something other than rule-following. After the rank fix all EIGHT rungs are load-bearing: carry_20 and no_plus_one went from 0 uses to 122 and 168, because choosing WHICH three distractors an item takes is now a rank decision and not first-come.

v1_replaced.defect: a content-free rule -- pick the 3rd-largest of the four numbers -- scored 0.6430, 39 points above the 25% the readout's power assumes. Gold's value rank was 6/245/643/106 across ranks 0-3. Structural in two rungs: sign_slip (3a+2b+1 on positive operands) is greater than gold on 298/298 and can never sit below it, and wrong_order is greater on 648/984, so the two most-used rungs crowd the top.
v1_replaced.why_it_was_missed: v1 shuffled the option POSITIONS and reported a chi-square on the label index. That statistic cannot see a heuristic over the option VALUES: the positions were uniform (chi2 1.936) while the values were not.
v1_replaced.found_by: e1 (lessons-58), 2026-09-05, by running a battery of content-free rules against the set
v1_replaced.headroom_cost: two-arm MDE at n=1000, alpha .05, power .80: from a 0.25 floor the treated arm needs 0.3048; from 0.6430 it needs 0.7026 -- 0.357 of headroom instead of 0.750 (e1's calculation).
v1_replaced.nothing_scored: v1 lived only on branch 3b and no arm ran against it

content_free_battery_v2.note: every rule reading only the four numbers is at chance; asserted in the selftest

v2_replaced.defect: balancing value rank and nearest-zero left a THIRD content-free rule live: closest-to-3*operands[0] scored 0.4190, closest-to-operands[k] 0.3450/0.3400/0.3580/0.3940, closest-to-sum 0.3910. Mechanism, not coincidence: gold is 3*a1 - 2*(the rest) + 1, so a1 enters with coefficient 3 while every rung of the ladder perturbs the LATER operands' contribution, leaving gold systematically nearer 3*a1 than its distractors. Worse with chain length -- 0.5360 on diamond_chain4 against 0.3020 on diamond_chain.
v2_replaced.found_by: e1 (lessons-58), 2026-09-05, 19-rule battery against the v2 build
v2_replaced.nothing_scored: v2 lived only on branch 3b for under an hour and no arm ran against it

v3_marginal_targets.why: Targeting the 16 (value_rank, proximity_rank) CELLS evenly gives value_rank [196,208,256,340] and proximity_rank [340,295,243,122] -- worse on both axes than balancing either alone, because two cells are structurally unreachable on all 1000 items: gold cannot be the 2nd-largest value AND farthest from 3*a1, since being far from 3*a1 in either direction pushes it toward an extreme of the value order (e1). Targeting the three MARGINALS directly and letting the joint fall out reaches flat on all of them. This was the second even-cell error here; the first asked for 1/2 where chance is 1/4. Same shape: a target stronger than the constraint needs.

battery_v3.note: 19 rules, all at chance; the selftest fails any above 0.30

four_way_readout.reachability_reconciliation: my enumeration gives gold reachable at value rank 0 on 442 items, 1 on 714, 2 on 950, 3 on 839; e1 measured 220/614/913/761 and traced their lower numbers to deduplicating the candidate subsets twice. four_way_content_free_floor.battery: 29 rules that read the four options and the operands and never apply the operator; mathbank/emit_novel_ops_4way.py:_battery()
four_way_content_free_floor.scored_per_program: REQUIRED. The floor differs by program and a pooled mean cancels opposite-leaning halves: in v3 closest_3sum was 0.4980 on diamond_chain4 (z=+12.81) and 0.0140 on diamond_chain (z=-12.19), pooling to 0.2560, which the pooled battery read as chance.
four_way_content_free_floor.why_not_0.25: Structural on 3-operand chains. Gold is the largest of four on only 23 of diamond_chain's 500 items, because sign_slip (3a+2b+1 on positive operands) and wrong_order both exceed gold, so the best reachable value-rank marginal is [23,159,159,159] -> 0.318 (e1, 2026-09-05). The displaced rank-0 mass lands in the middle ranks, where a SPREAD statistic reads it: nearest_mean_of_options picks value rank 1 on 354 of chain's 500 items and rank 2 on 146, never rank 0 or 3, and chain's gold sits at [23,150,162,165] so ranks 1-2 hold 312/500 against a flat 250 -- 0.3640. On diamond_chain4, where the rank marginal IS flat, the same rule scores 0.1840. That is the same infeasibility read by a different statistic, not a new leak family, and it is why balancing one more key does not converge: the mass moves to whatever reads it next. fb ruled 2026-09-05 that no further rungs are added and there is no v5.
four_way_content_free_floor.operational_floor: the no-injection control arm's own score, not this number. This is the prior.

v1.cause: gold at value rank 2 on 643/1000; the position chi-square cannot see a rule over the option VALUES

v2.cause: gold is 3*a1 - 2*(the rest) + 1, so a1 enters with coefficient 3 while every rung perturbs the later operands

v3.leak: per-program maxima 0.3840 diamond_chain (smallest) and 0.4980 diamond_chain4 (closest_3sum), against a pooled battery maximum of 0.2920
v3.cause: the three marginals were balanced over the pooled 1000 rows. The two programs reach different key sets, so a pooled target is met by over-filling one program's reachable keys against the other's.

v4_header_only.note: the same 1000 items (tail sha 78132162cea92202d745ad263bf174086c5c24a20dad9bdcb94f12d12639ddd9 on both) with a header recording 0.330/0.288, the maximum over a 23-rule battery. Superseded by adding six rules, not by rebuilding.

four_way_content_free_floor.certifies: the battery DETECTS a leak and cannot certify the absence of the next one. The rules are all 'gold is an affine functional of the operands and each distractor perturbs one term', an unbounded family: rank, then proximity to 3*a1, then proximity to 3*sum were closed in that order and each fix exposed the next.
four_way_content_free_floor.is_a_lower_bound_not_a_certificate: The recorded floor is the maximum over the rules that are IN the battery, so it can only rise as rules are added. It rose twice on this frozen artifact without the items changing: 0.330 -> 0.364 on diamond_chain when e1 contributed nearest_mean_of_options (0.3640, z=+5.89) and 0.288 -> 0.294 on diamond_chain4 with closest_2a1. All 1000 items are byte-identical across those two readings; only the measured maximum moved. Treat it as a lower bound on the achievable floor. The operational floor is the no-injection control arm's own score, which absorbs every member of the family including the unenumerated ones.

facts.uncertainty: The hashes are exact. What they cannot say is whether a regeneration was intended: the emitter is deterministic at these seeds, so re-running it on the same code reproduces these bytes, and a differing hash means the CODE changed, not the draw.
facts.boundary: This entry freezes the ARTIFACT, not the design. It does not say the sets measure a skill absent from pretraining -- that rests on construction and is recorded in cont.novel_operator_collision. A curve scored against any other hash is a different measurement and must say so. The divergence rates apply to S only. In P the carry never fires, so P cannot discriminate the three readings and a clean P label is not evidence the carry rule was applied -- that is correct for a format control and would be a defect in a transfer set. S and P also differ in operand magnitude (means 9.9 vs 48.6), not only in composition; see value.operand_magnitude_confound. Any S-minus-P number carries that term until it is ruled on. The 4-way set's content-free floor is 0.364 (diamond_chain) / 0.294 (diamond_chain4), NOT 0.25, and it must be scored per program: see value.four_way_content_free_floor. A pooled 4-way number is not interpretable. That floor is a maximum over the battery's rules and rose twice on an unchanged artifact as rules were added; it is a lower bound, not a certificate that no rule scores higher.

facts.unit: counts over the frozen item file; no model is run
facts.source: data/probes/api_cloze.jsonl at sha256 8524d9cb (commit 9b5b0c9c); recomputed from the file by e1, not copied from the header or from prereg amendment_12

config.why_this_exists: The control floor this file was built for was DROPPED the same day: readout_2_split's estimator is delta_seen - delta_unseen with each arm minus control, and readout_4_result_m1_one_layer STOPS M1 by the pool_touched_frac rule (0.0945 < 0.20) with M2/M3 stopped by controller ruling, so no live readout consumes a control number. The file's INTERNAL consistency is checkable with no GPU, so it is recorded here rather than re-derived by the next reader (4c's instruction).
config.what_the_label_distribution_rules_out: A 4-way probe whose gold sits disproportionately in one option slot can be beaten above chance by position alone. Max share is 0.2591 against 0.25, so position carries almost no signal; label_indexes_gold confirms options[label] == gold on every item, which is what makes the label usable at all.
config.what_the_boundary_check_rules_out: SEEN items must come from rows the control read and UNSEEN from rows the allocation never reached, or the difference-in-differences is diluted -- amendment_4 records an earlier boundary that would have diluted it ~8x into a false null. Zero seen rows reach the pinned unseen_lo, zero unseen rows fall outside the pinned region, and the two regions share no pool row.
config.agreement_with_the_header: The file's own header claims seen/unseen distinct_rows 929/924 and stats.items 2499/2499; both recomputed and identical. prereg amendment_12's claim that only unseen distinct_rows changed (925 -> 924) is therefore confirmed against the file.

facts.uncertainty: Exact counts, not estimates. They say nothing about whether the items are GOOD -- distractor plausibility, prompt truncation quality and whether an API name is guessable from the prefix are unmeasured, and no model has scored this file.
facts.boundary: Consistency of the artifact only. It is not evidence the readout would have been well-powered: the control's own accuracy against the 0.25 chance floor was never measured, so whether this probe can separate an arm from chance at this scale remains unknown.
